title: architecture v1 apply-state manifest
description: Interrupted-apply recovery metadata ONLY, with no semantic role whatsoever: losing this file can never change what the projection means, only whether an interrupted write needs resuming. It is created only for a NON-EMPTY changed set -- a semantic no-op writes zero bytes and creates no manifest at all -- after the plan is validated and before the first write. It claims no cross-file filesystem atomicity: atomicity is per file, and cross-file integrity comes from this manifest plus resume.

order.description: Dense and ascending from 0: deterministic write ordering is what makes 'advance after each write' unambiguous on resume.

before_hash.description: null when the file does not exist yet.
